## Fey Blessings [Fey HB]

**Blessing of the Sidhe (lesser):** You can touch a willing creature, giving it a blessing. For the next round, any time the target rolls a d20, he may roll twice and take the more favorable result.

**Summon Fey (major):** At 10th level, you can summon a fey creature as the Summon Fairy talent, using your warpriest level as your caster level, with a duration of 1 minute. This caster level stacks normally with those gained from other sources.
